user_prompt: Joey and Chandler argue about the right way to eat a sandwich, escalating into absurd territory in their apartment
description: High-comedy scene between Joey and Chandler — tests comedy_pacing and character_authenticity. Should demonstrate Joey's food obsession and Chandler's sarcastic deflection.
quality_notes: Joey must be completely earnest about sandwich mechanics — this is life-or-death to him. Chandler should undercut every sincere moment with self-deprecating sarcasm. Scene needs escalating absurdity with a payoff punchline.

dialogue.text: Okay, you are eating that sandwich completely wrong.
I'm eating it with my mouth. I feel like that's the correct method.
You bit into the middle! The middle, Chandler! The structural integrity is gone!
Could this BE any more of a sandwich emergency?
You always do this! You make fun of things you don't understand. Sandwiches have rules.
I went to college. I understand sandwiches. I'm just not sure sandwiches have a constitution.
They have a constitution AND a bill of rights. Corner to corner, Chandler. Corner. To. Corner.
I feel like I should have paid more attention in school.
